warning: This map is not an existing runtime. Nothing in the pack is a callable engine, and nothing here was found as a live API. A future game could read these files. The validator only simulates the seams below.
readOrder: Inject flags.era.<id> for the season being played. Do not store that injection as a quest reward.
Offer a quest only when its prerequisites pass and the player has encountered its discovery in the place.
Discoveries are diegetic. There is no compass, marker, or log-pin in this proposal.

seams.input: The season id E0 through E5, years 1952, 1966, 1980, 1994, 2008, 2022.
seams.effect: flags.era.<id> is true for that season and false for the others. People speak only if presentInEra would allow it.

seams.input: A quest or stage dialogue graph: start node, nodes with exactly one of choices, next, or end.
seams.effect: Choices may set flags and may require flags or a character-creation tuple. End nodes set a branchId, a status, and flags. Mutex groups clear sibling flags when one is set true.

seams.input: background, bond, ideal, flaw from data/character_creation.json.
seams.effect: The first matching textVariant replaces the node's base line. A variant matches when every character field in when equals the created tuple and every id in when.flags is true. World-state variants are listed before temperament variants, so a lived fact outranks a gloss. Variants do not change the graph. No combat class, no meter, no romance value.

seams.input: Ellis dies mid-quest, or the season advances with the quest unresolved or resolved.
seams.effect: Apply deathTransition.setsOnDeath. Carry flagsCarriedOnDeath. Drop flagsLostOnDeath. Use the alternate dialogue bundle if a listed NPC is dead.

seams.input: A set of living person ids, defaulting to birth and death years against the era clock, with optional deathOverrides.
seams.effect: If a characterIds member is dead, play that NPC's ifNpcDead bundle instead of the main graph.

nonGoals: No invented save API, network client, or engine object.
